crossRefs.note: I will tell of the decree: Yahweh said to me, “You are my son. Today I have become your father.
For whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among…
He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.
He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in all things he…
Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth.
Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.
Water shall flow from his buckets. His seed shall be in many waters. His king shall be higher than Agag. His kingdom…
therefore wisdom and knowledge is granted to you. I will give you riches, wealth, and honor, such as none of the kings…
All the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon, to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.
They each brought tribute, vessels of silver, vessels of gold, clothing, armor, spices, horses, and mules every year.
Yahweh, the Redeemer of Israel, and his Holy One, says to him whom man despises, to him whom the nation abhors, to a…
He has on his garment and on his thigh a name written, “KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.”
The nations will walk in its light. The kings of the earth bring the glory and honor of the nations into it.

translations.web: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
translations.bsb: I will indeed appoint him as My firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
translations.kjv: Also I will make him my firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.
translations.asv: I also will make him my first-born, The highest of the kings of the earth.
